hophr-hophr:lever:a7016e1a-2f71-41f7-88f.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
hophr-hophr:lever:a7016e1a-2f71-41f7-88f.description: Title: Full Stack Software Engineer Location: Los Angeles, CA We are seeking highly motivated, collaborative, and technically strong Full Stack Software Engineers to join our Enterprise Technology Application Development team at a well-known tech firm. The selected candidates will play a key role in building and maintaining a portfolio of internal business systems that support critical operational workflows across multiple domains within the organization. This is an exceptional opportunity for engineers who thrive in high-ownership environments and enjoy working across systems, architectures, and technologies. The role is best suited for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the ability to contribute effectively with minimal ramp-up in unfamiliar domains. Our application portfolio is built on a consistent and opinionated architectural foundation, enabling engineers to move between systems while maintaining high standards for code quality, maintainability, and operational reliability. The selected candidates will work closely with senior engineering leadership and help coordinate delivery execution with distributed offshore development resources. Responsibilities/Duties: • Build and deliver full-stack software features across backend services, APIs, databases, and frontend applications. • Develop and maintain Java and Spring Boot backend services supporting production business applications. • Build React and TypeScript user interfaces aligned to shared platform and design standards. • Design and implement relational database models, schema migrations, and API integrations. • Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture decisions, technical implementation, and delivery planning. Abilities: • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and modern full-stack development practices. • Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript frontend development. • Solid understanding of relational database design and PostgreSQL development. • Experience with Docker-based containerization and modern CI/CD workflows. • Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, codebases, and architectural patterns. • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to operate effectively in distributed engineering environments. • Experience integrating with financial systems, operational platforms, or enterprise business applications is advantageous. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience is required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:021cd5e2-4d6b-.title: Senior SEO Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:021cd5e2-4d6b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior SEO Account Manager based in United States. This is a senior, client-facing SEO role focused on helping U.S.-based home services businesses strengthen their local search visibility and generate measurable lead growth. You will own a portfolio of 8–10 client accounts, serving as the primary strategic partner and point of contact for business owners. The role combines local SEO strategy, hands-on implementation, performance analysis, and high-level client communication. You will have the autonomy to audit accounts, identify opportunities, execute improvements, and continuously optimize performance. AI and automation tools are integrated into the workflow, allowing you to focus more of your time on strategy, results, and meaningful client relationships. The ideal candidate is technically strong, proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable communicating SEO insights to sophisticated business leaders. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on client revenue while growing within a fast-paced, performance-driven digital marketing environment. Manage a portfolio of approximately 8–10 U.S.-based home services clients, taking ownership of local search performance, account strategy, and client satisfaction. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, leading onboarding calls, monthly strategy reviews, regular check-ins, and performance discussions. Conduct comprehensive local SEO audits, identify performance gaps and growth opportunities, and develop customized strategies for each account. Optimize and actively manage Google Business Profiles, including posts, photos, Q&A, reviews, profile information, and ongoing local search improvements. Implement on-site SEO improvements across WordPress websites, including technical fixes, metadata optimization, content improvements, and internal linking. Build and maintain local citations and directory listings while ensuring consistent and accurate NAP information. Monitor rankings, organic traffic, leads, and other performance indicators using tools such as BrightLocal, Whitespark, Google Search Console, and GA4. Translate SEO and performance data into clear, specific, and actionable recommendations for clients. Support social media planning and publishing for selected accounts when required. Monitor Google algorithm changes and emerging local SEO trends, proactively adapting strategies to protect and improve client performance. Leverage AI, automation, and other marketing technologies to streamline SEO workflows and improve efficiency without compromising quality. Take proactive ownership of account performance, identifying issues and opportunities before they become client concerns. Requirements 3–5+ years of hands-on local SEO experience, with a demonstrated record of improving rankings, organic traffic, and lead generation for local businesses. Strong expertise in Google Business Profile optimization and a comprehensive understanding of local search ranking factors. Proven experience managing multiple client accounts in an agency environment, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes and client retention. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and clearly with business owners and senior stakeholders. Strong understanding of on-site SEO for local businesses, including WordPress implementation, technical SEO fundamentals, metadata, content optimization, and internal linking. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret SEO performance data and convert insights into practical strategies. Highly proactive, accountable, organized, and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Comfortable working with AI tools, marketing automation platforms, and technology-enabled SEO workflows. Availability to work U.S. Central or Eastern Time hours to supp

jobgether-jobgether:lever:602fa54c-0aba-.title: Principal Engineering Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:602fa54c-0aba-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Engineering Manager based in Switzerland. Lead a critical engineering area within a fast-growing global technology organization and help raise the bar for product development. You’ll combine deep engineering judgment with people leadership, strategic thinking, and a strong sense of ownership. Working closely with Product and Design, you’ll shape solutions early, bring clarity to complex challenges, and guide teams toward sustainable execution. You’ll remain connected to the technical work while empowering engineers to make strong decisions and deliver with confidence. The role offers broad influence over engineering standards, architecture, delivery practices, and long-term product outcomes. You’ll operate in a globally distributed, inclusive environment that values collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and practical execution. This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and the teams behind products serving a global customer base. Lead and develop an engineering team by providing clear direction, context, coaching, feedback, and support for individual and collective growth. Partner closely with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery to shape effective solutions and align technical possibilities with customer and business needs. Own delivery from problem definition through execution, ensuring priorities, responsibilities, dependencies, and expected outcomes remain clear. Establish predictable and sustainable execution through thoughtful planning, realistic expectations, transparent progress tracking, and proactive risk management. Provide technical leadership across complex products and systems, making informed architectural and engineering decisions while remaining close to the work. Maintain high standards for engineering quality, scalability, reliability, maintainability, testing, and continuous delivery. Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, processes, collaboration, and delivery across the wider organization. Help engineers work effectively with modern development technologies, including AI-assisted tools and LLM-based coding assistants. Contribute strategic engineering experience and leadership to broader organizational initiatives and help create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. Requirements: Significant experience leading engineering teams within a product-focused technology organization. Proven track record of delivering complex products, platforms, or systems in fast-moving environments. Strong technical judgment and the ability to participate confidently in both engineering and product discussions. Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, establish clarity, and turn complex problems into actionable plans. Strong experience partnering with Product and Design to shape solutions, priorities, and product direction. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear context, align diverse stakeholders, and communicate effectively at all levels. Strong ownership mindset combined with a practical, execution-oriented approach to leadership. Experience working with modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices is highly valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as PHP/Symfony, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Helm is advantageous. Understanding of distributed architectures, scalable data processing, observability, automated testing, CI/CD, continuous delivery, and A/B testing is a plus. Experience using LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to improve implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and software quality is beneficial. Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed environment and collaborating asynchronously across functions and locations. Benefits: Fully remote position available wi

jobgether-jobgether:lever:827d849f-1f5b-.title: Payments Solution Architect
jobgether-jobgether:lever:827d849f-1f5b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Payments Solution Architect based in United Kingdom. This is a strategic and hands-on role at the intersection of digital payments, financial technology, and quality engineering. You will shape and scale payment testing solutions for complex, enterprise-grade transaction environments. The role combines technical architecture, commercial strategy, client advisory, and delivery leadership. You will design offerings, methodologies, staffing models, and pricing while solving sophisticated payment-quality challenges. Working closely with clients, sales, delivery teams, and technology partners, you will influence high-impact business opportunities. You will also help define the future of payments testing through thought leadership, innovation, and industry engagement. This is an opportunity to make a measurable difference to digital experiences used by millions of people worldwide. Shape the payments offering: Define, launch, package, and continuously evolve payment testing services, including the offering catalog, methodologies, staffing approaches, and pricing models. Set strategic direction: Develop and communicate a forward-looking vision for payments testing, identifying market opportunities, competitive trends, and innovative approaches that can expand the business. Drive commercial growth: Partner with sales teams on enterprise opportunities, participate in client conversations, advise prospects on payments testing strategies and ROI, and contribute expertise to pipeline development. Build strategic partnerships: Work with alliances teams and external technology, payments, commerce, and consulting partners to develop joint go-to-market opportunities. Design technical solutions: Analyze complex digital transaction architectures and create tailored quality engineering strategies for mobile payments, wallets, payment gateways, online banking, POS systems, and emerging agentic payment environments. Provide hands-on delivery expertise: Act as a senior subject-matter expert and escalation point, supporting engagements from initial scoping through test execution and delivery reviews. Resolve complex technical challenges: Troubleshoot payment integrations and quality-engineering roadblocks while protecting transaction integrity, security, compliance, and reliability across markets and payment instruments. Elevate client and delivery capabilities: Introduce new technical approaches, methodologies, and best practices to help delivery teams and enterprise clients improve their payments testing maturity. Lead thought leadership: Represent the payments testing vision through white papers, articles, webinars, conference presentations, industry discussions, and other external communications. Influence without direct authority: Inspire and coordinate distributed, cross-functional teams while building strong relationships with technical specialists, business leaders, clients, and partners. Requirements: 10+ years of deep payments experience , with strong knowledge of digital payment ecosystems such as mobile payments, online banking, payment gateways, digital wallets, and point-of-sale systems. Strong quality engineering expertise , including a technical understanding of API integrations, software development methodologies, and testing practices within financial or transaction-heavy environments. Proven solution architecture and troubleshooting skills , with the ability to analyze complex transaction flows, identify integration issues, and establish structured evaluation criteria. Client-facing consulting or managed-services experience , ideally involving technical discovery, solution design, advisory work, and engagement with enterprise stakeholders. Commercial and strategic acumen , including experience developing service offerings, understanding cost-to-serve considerations, and collaborating with sales, allianc

jobgether-jobgether:lever:93d220bb-2f86-.title: Associate Project Manager, Sample Solutions
jobgether-jobgether:lever:93d220bb-2f86-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Project Manager, Sample Solutions based in India. This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career project professional to support the delivery of online sample and sample-driven market research projects. You will manage low-to-mid complexity projects from launch through completion while supporting senior team members on more complex engagements. The role combines project coordination, fieldwork management, client communication, data analysis, and operational quality control. You will work closely with Sales, Research Solutions, Operations, Programming, and external sample providers to keep projects on track. Your work will directly contribute to project quality, client satisfaction, timely delivery, and efficient use of resources. This role offers a fast-paced, collaborative environment where strong organization, analytical thinking, and attention to detail can make a measurable impact. Support the end-to-end execution of low-to-mid complexity online sample and sample-driven market research projects, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met. Coordinate project launch activities, confirm fieldwork readiness, and monitor projects throughout the fielding process. Track key field performance indicators, including incidence, completion rates, quotas, respondent flow, and project timelines. Conduct data checks and quality assurance reviews during fieldwork and take action when performance or quality issues arise. Manage fieldwork closeout activities, including reconciliations and honorarium-related processes. Maintain proactive and professional communication with clients, providing project updates and escalating risks or issues when appropriate. Collaborate with Sales, Research Solutions, Programming, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to align project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables. Assist with sample planning and quota structures, including click-balancing and sampling adjustments during fieldwork. Troubleshoot field performance challenges, recommend corrective actions, and coordinate with third-party sample vendors to optimize respondent flow and quality. Support revenue tracking, forecasting, invoice preparation, and reconciliation activities for assigned projects. Ensure scope changes are properly documented, communicated, and reflected in project records. Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, and debrief materials throughout the project lifecycle. Contribute to process consistency, operational compliance, and continuous improvement within the Sample Solutions function. Requirements: At least 2 years of relevant project coordination or project management experience , ideally within market research, online sampling, sample operations, or a related environment. Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. Understanding of market research fundamentals and primary research methodologies. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients, colleagues, and external partners. Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the ability to interpret field performance data and identify potential issues. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace . Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a distributed, cross-functional team. Experience working with online panels or third-party sample providers is a plus. Familiarity with CRM, project management, or project tracking systems is advantageous. Experience managing quotas, click-balancing, or complex targeting criteria is preferred. Experience creating project docume

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:7487a7.title: Senior Commercial Counsel
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:7487a7.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As our Senior Commercial Counsel, you’ll be the legal backbone of our sales motion: responsible for reviewing, redlining, and negotiating contracts with a wide variety of customers and partners. You’ll work closely with Sales and Leadership to keep deals moving while protecting Profound’s interests. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Review, redline, and negotiate a variety of outbound (sell-side) commercial agreements, procurement agreements, partnership agreements, and bespoke business development deals - Act as the primary legal contact for Sales to facilitate the entire deal process from A to Z through contract execution - Create and maintain contract templates and playbooks for efficiency - Implement and continue to iterate on the company’s AI legal ops strategy - Monitor data privacy, AI, and IP regulations to provide actionable guidance WHO YOU ARE - 6-10 years of legal experience, with at least 2 years negotiating B2B SaaS contracts at a global in-house data-centric SaaS organization with high deal velocity. - Above all, you must have excellent judgment and critical thinking skills. - You have an obsession with internal client and external customer happiness, with a demonstrated history of promoting scalable processes and procedures. - You are independent, patient, thoughtful, and adept at managing shifting priorities in a demanding, fast-paced environment, but at the same time possess the judgment to know when and how to escalate issues. - Ability to manage the sales contract review process autonomously - Skilled in the transactional aspects of GDPR - Pragmatic approach to balancing legal risk and business needs - Exceptional communication skills for conveying legal concepts to non-lawyers - Experience in-house at a high-growth AI/data-centric products is a major plus - Licensed to practice law in the U.S. LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $240,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
